edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Thanksgiving weekend brings two shows to Walhalla Performing Arts Center — a Fleetwood Mac tribute Friday and Celtic Angels Christmas Sunday — plus a window-decorating contest and a little man-made snow downtown, a holiday market and workshops at the Seneca Treehouse Project, and both lakeside breweries running their usual Friday-through-Sunday music and food trucks.

events.title: Rumours: A Fleetwood Mac Tribute Returns 2026
events.body: The long-running Fleetwood Mac tribute act plays the Walhalla Performing Arts Center stage for a post-Thanksgiving night out. Note: some ticket resellers list this wrong — the venue's own calendar confirms Friday.

events.title: Window decorating contest and a little snow, downtown Walhalla
events.body: Downtown businesses deck out their storefronts for the City of Walhalla's holiday window contest, with community leaders judging and prizes for the winners. Up the street at the Sunni Ann Mercantile, "It's Snowing at the Mercantile" brings artificial snowfall, giveaways, and specials for a half hour.
events.note: Snow event free, 1–1:30pm · window contest all day, downtown Walhalla

events.title: Free live music Friday and Saturday at Keowee Brewing
events.body: Keowee Brewing runs live music both nights, rain or shine, like clockwork — the lineup posts to their Facebook events page closer to showtime rather than the website, so check there or ask at the bar.
events.note: Free · 6:30–8:30pm Fri & Sat · Keowee Brewing, 401 E. Main St., Seneca

events.title: Weekend music and food trucks at Jocassee Valley Brewing
events.body: Closed Thanksgiving Day, Jocassee Valley Brewing reopens Friday at noon with Spalding McIntosh (Caribbean) and Just A Smile's truck, Saturday brings West End Strings and Buns and Bones, and Sunday closes with Jay Maybry (country) and Farm to Fire Fermentery's wood-fired pizza.
events.note: Free to attend · Fri 12–9pm, Sat 9am–9pm, Sun 12–7pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

events.title: Green Saturday holiday market and make-n-take workshops
events.body: The Seneca Treehouse Project's holiday market is free to browse — handmade gifts and vendors — with ticketed make-n-take workshops (charcuterie boards, infused oil rollers, intention candles) and kids' activities alongside it. Check the event page for the workshop schedule and the VIP All Access Pass.
events.note: Market free · workshops ticketed · Seneca Treehouse Project

events.title: Celtic Angels Christmas 2026
events.body: A Sunday matinee of Irish and Celtic holiday music and dance closes out the weekend at the Walhalla Performing Arts Center.

plan.title: Eat in Walhalla before the Fleetwood Mac tribute
plan.body: The show starts at 7:30pm, so grab dinner downtown first — there's plenty within walking distance of the PAC.

plan.title: Get on the water before the holiday crowds
plan.body: Late-November mornings are cold and quiet and the ramps are empty — launch early on Keowee or Jocassee before heading into town for the Treehouse market.

plan.title: Check the lake level before the Celtic Angels matinee
plan.body: See where Keowee and Jocassee stand before you wrap up the long weekend with the 3pm show in Walhalla.
